Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing the department of labor and industries to issue subpoenas to enforce production of information related to electricians and electrical installations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to authorizing the department of labor andindustries to issue subpoenas, but only with respect to enforcement ofchapter 19.28 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 19.28 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.28 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) If he or she has reason to believe there has been a violationof this chapter, the director and the director's authorizedrepresentatives may issue subpoenas to enforce the production andexamination of any information, whether written or electronic,necessary to enforce this chapter. (2) The subpoena may be issued only if an electrical contractor,administrator, electrician, or other entity or person to which thischapter applies fails to provide information described in subsection(1) of this section when requested by the department. (3) The superior court has the power to enforce such a subpoena byproper proceedings. (4) This section applies to all electrical contractors, p. 1 SSB 6492administrators, electricians, other entities and persons, andelectrical work to which this chapter applies. (5) The secretary of the board must provide the board with thefollowing information before the board's quarterly meetings: A listdetailing all the subpoenas that have been issued in the previousquarter; why those subpoenas were issued; and the results of thesubpoena being issued. Any member of the board may request a fulldiscussion of any subpoena at the board meeting.
